title.narrative: Provision of Early lifesaving WASH response to vulnerable communities and IDPs projected to be most affected by El Nino in Luuq district of Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:9.95ptmargin-right:0cmmargin-bottom: 9.95ptmargin-left:0cm"gtLuuq district is characterized by concurrently numerous barriers and inequalities in accessing WASH services, including geographical barriers, where some of the target communities live in rural settings, and other vulnerable groups are unable to access WASH services due to inappropriate design, and economic barriers i.e. high construction costs, connection charges and tariffs that limit people’s access to safe and affordable serviceslt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtThe combination of a severe drought, widespread insecurity and economic pressures is pushing people in Somalia towards famine. Estimated 5 million people are experiencing crisis or worse outcomes, and with 96,000 people facing catastrophic hunger. According to FAO 2023 report, cites that an approaching El Niño climate event has the potential to negatively affect 1.2 million people in Somalia this year, action must be taken now to protect lives and livelihoods, riverine communities in Somalia are most at risk, an estimated 1.5 million hectares of land are at risk of flooding - anticipatory action can prevent the worst. Most of the newly displaced persons living in IDP camps as well as in rural areas lack latrines and are practicing open defecation which will lead to disease outbreaks such as AWD/Cholera.lt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtThus, ADA is proposing a 8-months project to save lives and reduce the impact of the projected disastrous EL-Nino on communities at greatest risk and address the identified gaps in the provision of WASH services in Luuq district. The project will target 20,400 people at risk of Elnino flooding living in both IDP camps within the town and villages in rural areas. lt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtThe project aims to provide the following key services to the target beneficiaries: Provision of temporary safe water supply to target 2000hhs (12000 men, women, boys and girls) most vulnerable IDPs and rural communities in Luuq district for a period of two months. Water vouchers will be used for distribution. lt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gt-Upgrade/repair 8 unprotected shallow wells at risk due to El Nino flooding equipped with hand pumps and other protection features. The shallow wells are situated in the following, Garmadow IDP, Boyle IDP, Cara Case village, Hodey village, Abdikheyr village, Afmadow village and Helashiid Village. ADA will conduct mass treatment of unprotected water sources and post flooding shock chlorination of wells and routine water quality monitoring to prevent AWD/cholera outbreak in Luuq.. lt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gt-Rehabilitate 1 communal strategic water source at Abaqley village and construct 25m³ Elevated water tank equipped with solar powered pumping systems, distribution networks and water kiosk targeting riverine communities affected by floods and at risk of cholera outbreaks.lt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gt-Construct 80 emergency flood-resilient latrines targeting vulnerable displaced people with no access to basic sanitation facilities. The emergency sanitation facilities will be constructed in (Boyle, Wadajir, Jaziira and Garmadow IDPs camps) with 12 of the latrines for people living with disability. lt/pgt
ltpgt-Train and Sensitize 100 (66 men, 34 women) key community stakeholders on the project activities, AWD/cholera prevention and community mobilization.ltbrgt -Procurement and distribution of 3,000 household hygiene kits to prevent spread of waterborne disease outbreaks associated with forecasted El Nino event including -3,000 sanitary pads for vulnerable newly drought displaced IDPs girls and women. ltbrgt -Procurement and distribution of 60 standard sanitation tool kits to the communities at risk of El Nino flooding to support clearing waterways and for environmental sanitation clean-ups.ltbrgt -Installation of 15 standalone handwashing stations in two schools (Nuur Shariif Shaadhibi Primary schools) and three healthcare facilities (Jazira OTP/TSFP, Ankaro Health and Kormare Health centers) to maintain the required level of hygiene practices.lt/pgtltpgt-Conduct 34 hygiene promotion sessions including house to house visit to disseminate hygiene and sanitation messages to mitigate potential AWD/Cholera outbreaksltbrgtlt/pgt
